body.p: Goose Once a gosling from warm countries returned, built a house near a large lake, built a nest for himself. There he began to live. And on this lake, the divers are making noise, making noise, diving. One day the goose says: âChildren, why are you making noise, the watermanâs head will hurt, be quieter. Your head will hurt. Why make noise, I'm quietly flying peacefully. Here the gosling says: âI bring up seven children on the shore of the lake, live quietly and peacefully, and calmly lead my seven children through life.â The goose looks: the duck weeps bitterly, she left one of her children as a sacrifice to the Waterman. The diver cries bitterly: she left her baby. The comrades have all left. So it happened, in the autumn all the comrades flew away, what is there to tell. One child was left as a sacrifice to the Vodyanoy because during the summer they made his head hurt. And the goose flew over the dives and said: âI lived quietly peacefully during the summer. Therefore, I raised my seven children and now we are all flying to warmer climes. All the birds have flown away. Winter came, and the dive baby froze and died. That's why I say: "Children, you can't, don't make noise, someone's head will hurt."
